bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest Bears story is the fallout from their Monday night win, as stellar performances by third-string quarterback Case Keenum and a stifling defense led the Bears to an impressive 27-7 win over the Eagles Monday night at Soldier Field . With Caleb Williams still sidelined by a hamstring injury, attention has now turned to whether Case Keenum supplanted Tyson Bagent as the Chicago Bears' No.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions improved to 2-1 after a thrilling 31-24 victory over the New York Jets at Ford Field, with Jahmyr Gibbs scoring three touchdowns, the last on an 11-yard catch with 2:25 left, to lift Detroit to the win . Despite the offensive success, the defense remains a concern as Kelvin Sheppard's squad has given up a total of 95 points through the first three games of the 2026 season , and the team now looks ahead as small betting favorites against the Panthers in Week 4.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers continued bolstering their battered offensive line by signing veteran guard Kevin Zeitler, a former Pro Bowler who grew up in Wisconsin and played for the Badgers, returning to his home state to play professionally , marking the third o-line move this week after previously signing Laken Tomlinson off the Cowboys' practice squad and working out and signing former first-round pick Mekhi Becton . The 1-2 Packers are dealing with a rash of injuries as star pass rusher Micah Parsons will be out for at least another week amid his ACL recovery , while the team also announced roster moves releasing RB Damon Bankston and G Cordell Volson from the practice squad.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Vikings story over the last 24 hours is the fallout from Monday's blockbuster trade, as the team moved on from J.J. McCarthy, trading him to the New York Giants, leaving them with an interesting 2027 offseason situation at QB .
